```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r paths}
# Project-root relative paths. Place the historical inputs in these locations.
phylo_dir <- here("data", "raw", "phylogenetics", "cnidaria")
taxonomy_file <- here("data", "interim", "phylogenetics", "species_hv_names_tax.xlsx")
mantel_dir <- here("results", "global_analyses", "mantel")
output_dir <- here("results", "global_analyses", "phylogenetic_residuals", "cnidaria")
figures_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

required_files <- c(
  file.path(phylo_dir, "Cnidaria_Distance_Matrix_COI_MEGA.xlsx"),

  file.path(mantel_dir, "species_order.csv"),
  file.path(mantel_dir, "mantel_residuals_schoener.rds"),

)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Required input files are missing:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

# CNIDARIA

## Leer matriz genética COI de Cnidaria

```{r}
genetic_long <- read_excel(
  file.path(phylo_dir, "Cnidaria_Distance_Matrix_COI_MEGA.xlsx"),
  sheet = "MatrixOutput"
)

head(genetic_long)
names(genetic_long)
```
## Preparar tabla código COI -> especie

```{r}
norm <- function(x) enc2utf8(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x)))

coi_map <- species_hv_names_tax_Cnidaria %>%
  filter(COI == "Yes", !is.na(COI_ID)) %>%
  mutate(
    species = norm(species),
    COI_ID = norm(COI_ID),
    COI_ID_dot = paste0(COI_ID, ".1")
  ) %>%
  select(species, COI_ID, COI_ID_dot)

if (anyDuplicated(coi_map$COI_ID)) {
  stop("COI_ID must uniquely identify a Cnidaria species in the mapping table.")
}
coi_map
```


## Limpiar matriz genética larga

```{r}
genetic_long_clean <- genetic_long %>%
  rename(
    code1 = `Species 1`,
    code2 = `Species 2`,
    genetic_dist = Dist
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    code1 = norm(code1),
    code2 = norm(code2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(coi_map, by = c("code1" = "COI_ID")) %>%
  rename(sp1 = species) %>%
  left_join(coi_map, by = c("code2" = "COI_ID")) %>%
  rename(sp2 = species) %>%
  select(sp1, sp2, genetic_dist)

# Unmatched COI identifiers would otherwise create NA names in the genetic matrix.
if (anyNA(genetic_long_clean$sp1) || anyNA(genetic_long_clean$sp2)) {
  print(genetic_long_clean %>% filter(is.na(sp1) | is.na(sp2)))
  stop("Some COI identifiers could not be mapped to species; check the mapping table.")
}
if (!is.numeric(genetic_long_clean$genetic_dist) ||
    any(!is.finite(genetic_long_clean$genetic_dist))) {
  stop("Genetic distances must be finite numeric values.")
}
```

```{r}
genetic_long_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(sp1) | is.na(sp2))
```

```{r}
length(unique(genetic_long_clean$sp1))
length(unique(genetic_long_clean$sp2))
```

```{r}
length(unique(c(genetic_long_clean$sp1, genetic_long_clean$sp2)))

sort(unique(c(genetic_long_clean$sp1, genetic_long_clean$sp2)))
```

## Crear matriz genética simétrica

```{r}
gen_species <- sort(unique(c(genetic_long_clean$sp1, genetic_long_clean$sp2)))

gen_mat <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(gen_species),
  ncol = length(gen_species),
  dimnames = list(gen_species, gen_species)
)

for(i in seq_len(nrow(genetic_long_clean))) {
  s1 <- genetic_long_clean$sp1[i]
  s2 <- genetic_long_clean$sp2[i]
  d  <- genetic_long_clean$genetic_dist[i]
  
  gen_mat[s1, s2] <- d
  gen_mat[s2, s1] <- d
}

diag(gen_mat) <- 0

gen_mat[seq_len(min(5, nrow(gen_mat))), seq_len(min(5, ncol(gen_mat)))]
```

## Convertir residuos a matriz con nombres

```{r}
make_resid_mat <- function(resid_obj, species_order) {
  mat <- as.matrix(resid_obj$residuals)
  if (nrow(mat) != length(species_order) || ncol(mat) != length(species_order)) {
    stop("Residual matrix dimensions do not match species_order.csv")
  }
  rownames(mat) <- species_order
  colnames(mat) <- species_order
  mat <- (mat + t(mat)) / 2
  diag(mat) <- 0
  mat
}
```

## Crear matrices de residuos con nombres

```{r}
resid_schoener_mat <- make_resid_mat(resid_schoener, species_order)
resid_jaccard_mat  <- make_resid_mat(resid_jaccard, species_order)

head(resid_schoener_mat)
```

## Alinear residuos con especies de Cnidaria con COI

```{r}
species_common_schoener <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(resid_schoener_mat),
  rownames(gen_mat),
  colnames(gen_mat)
))

species_common_jaccard <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(resid_jaccard_mat),
  rownames(gen_mat),
  colnames(gen_mat)
))

length(species_common_schoener)
species_common_schoener
if (length(species_common_schoener) < 3L || length(species_common_jaccard) < 3L) {
  stop("At least three common species are required for each Mantel test.")
}
```


## Subset final

```{r}
resid_schoener_cnidaria <- resid_schoener_mat[species_common_schoener, species_common_schoener]
resid_jaccard_cnidaria  <- resid_jaccard_mat[species_common_jaccard, species_common_jaccard]

gen_cnidaria_schoener <- gen_mat[species_common_schoener, species_common_schoener]
gen_cnidaria_jaccard  <- gen_mat[species_common_jaccard, species_common_jaccard]
```


## Mantel: residuos vs distancia genética

```{r}
set.seed(123) # Reproducible permutations; p-values may differ from the historical HTML.
mantel_resid_gen_schoener <- mantel(
  as.dist(resid_schoener_cnidaria),
  as.dist(gen_cnidaria_schoener),
  permutations = 999,
  method = "pearson"
)

mantel_resid_gen_jaccard <- mantel(
  as.dist(resid_jaccard_cnidaria),
  as.dist(gen_cnidaria_jaccard),
  permutations = 999,
  method = "pearson"
)

mantel_resid_gen_schoener
mantel_resid_gen_jaccard
```


## Guardar matrices y resultados

Estas salidas se guardan por separado de los residuos globales generados en `06_02`.

```{r}
saveRDS(gen_mat, file.path(output_dir, "genetic_distance_matrix.rds"))
saveRDS(resid_schoener_cnidaria, file.path(output_dir, "resid_schoener_cnidaria_COI.rds"))
saveRDS(resid_jaccard_cnidaria, file.path(output_dir, "resid_jaccard_cnidaria_COI.rds"))

write.csv(gen_mat, file.path(output_dir, "genetic_distance_matrix.csv"))

mantel_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("Schoener residuals", "Jaccard residuals"),
  mantel_r = c(
    unname(mantel_resid_gen_schoener$statistic),
    unname(mantel_resid_gen_jaccard$statistic)
  ),
  p_value = c(
    mantel_resid_gen_schoener$signif,
    mantel_resid_gen_jaccard$signif
  ),
  n_species = c(
    length(species_common_schoener),
    length(species_common_jaccard)
  )
)

write.csv(
  mantel_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "mantel_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

mantel_summary
```


## PLOTS

```{r}
# preparar datos (solo triángulo superior)
get_upper <- function(mat) mat[upper.tri(mat)]

df_plot_schoener <- data.frame(
  schoener_resid = get_upper(resid_schoener_cnidaria),
  genetic = get_upper(gen_cnidaria_schoener)
)

plot_phylo_schoener <- ggplot(df_plot_schoener, aes(x = genetic, y = schoener_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2, shape = 16, color = "#80cdc1") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
            color = "#018571",
            fill = "grey80",   # ← cambia el gris
            alpha = 0.4,
            linewidth = 1)+
  labs(
    title = "Phylogenetic effects on residual co-occurrence (Schoener)",
    x = "Genetic distance (COI)",
    y = "Residual co-occurrence (Schoener)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

plot_phylo_schoener
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  file.path(figures_dir, "plot_phylo_residuals_schoener_Cnidaria.png"),
  plot = plot_phylo_schoener,
  width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600
)
```
